correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=1 with a+b>=3, all facets and maximal-cone incidence lists are established explicitly. Toric local Cartier slopes yield h_{ij}^{s,t}=s p_i+t q_j+c with p_i,q_j,c integral, giving the primitive anticanonical generator. The signed-ray lattice contains 2N and has mod-2 rank d-1, hence Cl torsion Z/2. Adding the constant-one Cartier generator yields a lattice containing 2(N+Z) with mod-2 rank d-1, hence two Z/2 summands; free ranks follow from matrix dimensions. An exact beta-integral volume gives 2^d a!b!, and six exact symbolic instances independently check ranks, Smith invariants and Ehrhart differences. The proof, not the finite checks, handles all parameters.

value.rationale: The objects are standard unconditional stable-set reflexive polytopes of complete bipartite graphs. The exact rank and two order-two Weil–Cartier obstructions determine integral geometric invariants not captured by rational Picard rank or reflexivity; the infinite family has unbounded free defect, primitive anticanonical polarization, and an exact degree. These are natural reusable classification benchmarks rather than arbitrary finite numerical entries.
